blocks.text: Pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds unhein “aapas mein chipke” rehne dete hain. Ek hi qisam ke molecules ki aapas ki is kashish ko cohesion kehte hain. Pani ke molecules mein cohesion zyada hai, aur yeh jandaron ke liye aham hai. Poday jaron (roots) se patton (leaves) tak pani aur nutrients (ghizai ajza) pohanchane ke liye isi cohesion par depend karte hain. Patte se pani ke bhaap banne se patte ki xylem vessels (pani le jane wali naliyon) ke pani par khinchao (pull) parta hai. Cohesion ki wajah se yeh khinchao xylem vessels ke zariye neeche jaron tak pohanchta hai. Natije mein pani gravity (zameen ki kashish) ke khilaf upar chadhta hai.

blocks.alt: Gehre neele-surmai pani par khara water strider, kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq: patla halka bhoora jism zara tircha, do chhoti agli tangen aur chaar bohat lambi patli tangen phaili hui; har taang ka sira pani ki satah mein ek chhota roshan gaddha (dimple) banata hai magar satah nahin torta.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.10: Pani ki satah par chalta hua water strider (kitab ki Figure 4.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Hydrogen bonds pani ko zyada surface tension (satah ka khinchao) bhi dete hain. Pani aise lagta hai jaise us par koi an-dekhi jhilli (film) chadhi ho. Figure 4.10 mein dekhein: water-strider keera satah tore baghair pani par chal leta hai.
